Choose from Starter Suite, Pro Suite, Core, Advanced, and Max — each with increasing levels of AI, automation, integration, and customization. ### How does Sales Cloud pricing work? Sales Cloud pricing follows a per-user, per-month subscription model. Pricing varies by edition, with each offering different features and levels of functionality to fit your business needs. ### How much does Starter Suite cost? [Starter Suite](https://www.salesforce.com/small-business/starter/) costs $25 USD per user, per month. It's an all-in-one CRM designed for small businesses, bringing together sales, service, marketing and commerce tools. Plus, it includes Slack at no extra cost for seamless collaboration.

Sales Cloud offers flexible pricing plans to grow with your business. Choose from Starter Suite, Pro Suite, Core, Advanced, and Max — each with increasing levels of AI, automation, integration, and customization. Want help finding the right fit? [Request a call](https://www.salesforce.com/company/contact-us/?d=cta-body-promo-274) with a Salesforce account executive to learn more. ### How does Sales Cloud pricing work? Sales Cloud pricing follows a per-user, per-month subscription model. You pay a monthly fee for each user who needs access. Pricing varies by edition, with each offering different features and levels of functionality to fit your business needs. ### Is there a free version of Sales Cloud? Salesforce offers a free 30-day trial for all Sales Cloud editions, with simple setup so you can get started quickly and explore key sales capabilities. If you'd like to explore an all-in-one CRM experience across sales, service, marketing, commerce, and Slack, you can also start a [free 30-day trial of Starter Suite](https://www.salesforce.com/small-business/free-trial/starter-suite/?d=pb) for up to 10 users. ### How much does Starter Suite cost? [Starter Suite](https://www.salesforce.com/small-business/starter/) costs $25 USD per user, per month. It's an all-in-one CRM designed for small businesses, bringing together sales, service, marketing and commerce tools. Plus, it includes Slack at no extra cost for seamless collaboration. ### What is the Sales Cloud Core plan? Sales Cloud Core is an advanced CRM for sales teams, with built-in AI and automation to help grow revenue faster. It includes everything in Pro Suite, plus advanced pipeline management and forecasting, opportunity scoring, conversation intelligence, APIs and Agentforce with the free Salesforce Foundations add-on. ### Are there upfront costs or additional fees? Salesforce has all kinds of add-ons, apps, and additional products to help your company stay ahead in your industry. Call us at 1-800-664-9073 to discuss exactly what kind of products you’re looking to add and how we can help. ### What if my business priorities and product needs have changed? We know things don’t always go according to plan, and we’re here and will try our best to support. Reach out to a sales representative at 1-800-664-9073 to discuss options. ### Do Salesforce products integrate with outside applications and systems? In many cases, Salesforce products integrate directly with many outside applications and systems to help you connect your data. For those that don’t have built-in integration, like on-premises data sources, you can purchase licenses of MuleSoft, work with our integration partners, or use apps on AgentExchange. Talk to a sales representative to get an idea of what integration solution works best with the Salesforce products you use. ### What support and service packages are available? We offer several advisory, adoption, and support plans to our customers. To learn more, visit [Success Cloud](https://www.salesforce.com/services/). ### How long are your contracts? Most Salesforce products use annual contracts, but Salesforce subscription terms vary. Chat with a sales representative to discuss payment and billing options for your products. ### Can I upgrade at any time? Can I add more products later on? You can add products or upgrade at any time, but some products may need to scale together. Reach out to our sales department at 1-800-664-9073 to see what works for your business. ### How much does CRM cost?
CRM pricing varies based on your needs. [Salesforce’s CRM](https://www.salesforce.com/crm/) is scalable so that you only have to pay for the features you use — and you can add or remove them as your needs change. You can find [product-specific information and pricing here](https://www.salesforce.com/pricing/).

### What are the different pricing plans available for Salesforce CRM?
Salesforce offers several pricing plans to cater to different business needs. These include [Starter Suite](https://www.salesforce.com/small-business/starter/) and [Pro Suite](https://www.salesforce.com/small-business/pro-suite/), [Enterprise,](https://www.salesforce.com/sales/free-trial/ee/?d=pb) and [U](https://www.salesforce.com/sales/free-trial/ue/?d=pb) [nlimited](https://www.salesforce.com/sales/free-trial/ue/?d=pb). Each plan comes with a unique set of features and capabilities to help you manage and strengthen your customer relationships.

### What is included in the Starter Suite plan?
Starter Suite is a complete CRM suite designed for [small businesses](https://www.salesforce.com/small-business/) that brings marketing, sales, service, and commerce tools together in one place. With Starter Suite, you can organize data, manage customer relationships, and gain insights into your business with one simple solution.

### How much does CRM cost?

CRM pricing varies based on your needs. [Salesforce’s CRM](https://www.salesforce.com/crm/) is scalable so that you only have to pay for the features you use — and you can add or remove them as your needs change. You can find [product-specific information and pricing here](https://www.salesforce.com/pricing/).

### What are the different pricing plans available for Salesforce CRM?

Salesforce offers several pricing plans to cater to different business needs. These include [Starter Suite](https://www.salesforce.com/small-business/starter/) and [Pro Suite](https://www.salesforce.com/small-business/pro-suite/), [Enterprise,](https://www.salesforce.com/sales/free-trial/ee/?d=pb) and [U](https://www.salesforce.com/sales/free-trial/ue/?d=pb) [nlimited](https://www.salesforce.com/sales/free-trial/ue/?d=pb). Each plan comes with a unique set of features and capabilities to help you manage and strengthen your customer relationships.

### Can I try Salesforce CRM before committing to a plan?

Yes. Salesforce offers a [free trial](https://www.salesforce.com/crm/free-trial/) of our [CRM solution](https://www.salesforce.com/crm/) so that you can explore all of the [features](https://www.salesforce.com/crm/features/) and functionalities before making a purchase decision. Simply sign up for your [free 30-day trial](https://www.salesforce.com/small-business/free-trial/starter-suite-v2/?d=pb). Then use the guided onboarding feature to get familiar with the platform.

### What is included in the Starter Suite plan?

Starter Suite is a complete CRM suite designed for [small businesses](https://www.salesforce.com/small-business/) that brings marketing, sales, service, and commerce tools together in one place. With Starter Suite, you can organize data, manage customer relationships, and gain insights into your business with one simple solution. Watch the [demo video](https://www.salesforce.com/small-business/demos/smb-overview/?d=pb) to see Starter Suite in action.

### What is included in the Pro Suite plan?

[Pro Suite](https://www.salesforce.com/small-business/pro-suite/) takes the complete CRM suite to the next level. It builds upon Starter Suite with even more marketing, sales, service, and commerce tools in a single app. Pro Suite helps you manage your unique business processes with upgraded features, like customization and automation, as well as additional apps that support your needs. Watch the [demo video](https://www.salesforce.com/small-business/demos/smb-overview/?d=pb) to see Pro Suite features in action.

### I’m an existing customer. How do I activate Foundations?

Enterprise customers and above can [activate Foundations for free](https://www.salesforce.com/crm/foundations/#activate-foundations) directly in ‘Your Account’ to add key features in Agentforce, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and Commerce Cloud - directly in your existing CRM. With Foundations you can start using Agentforce for free - with 1,000 conversations to get started.

### Are there any additional costs for add-ons or integrations?

Salesforce offers various add-ons and integrations, some of which may require additional costs. These include advanced analytics, marketing automation, and third-party integrations. It's important to review the pricing details for these add-ons to understand the total cost of your CRM solution.

### Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan at any time?

Yes. Salesforce is built to scale as your needs change. You can add products or upgrade to different plans, though some products may need to scale together. Reach out to our sales department at 18006649073 to see what works for your business.

[Call Us](tel:18006649073)
